summary.text: Samantha Vang is a Democratic state representative from Minnesota House District 38B who has served in the Minnesota House since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working as a housing advocate.

paragraphs.text: Samantha Vang lives in Brooklyn Center, Minnesota, and earned a B.A. in political science and communications from Gustavus Adolphus College in 2016.
Her career experience includes working as a housing advocate.
Ballotpedia lists Vang's tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2019, and her current term ends on January 12, 2027.
She chaired the Agriculture Finance and Policy Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Agriculture Finance and Policy, Legacy Finance, and Ways and Means committees, and she co-chairs the Legacy Finance Committee.
